items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is universal purity above y at source lines 1106-1120, label lemma-finite-type-flat-pure-along-fibre-is-universal, whose proof occupies source lines 1122-1143. The proof is a reduction strategy in three steps: flat base change to the strictly henselian local spectrum, the etale freeness construction along the fibre, and the passage from freeness to universal purity through the relative assassin image criterion. Each step is a verifiable reduction with hypotheses checked against the statement, and the counted statement records none of the reduction strategy.
